# Lab Manager

> Lab Manager provides expert guidance on running laboratories as efficient, compliant businesses through management strategies, safety protocols, leadership development, and emerging technology adoption.

Lab Manager serves laboratory directors, managers, and scientific leaders with comprehensive resources spanning lab operations, compliance, safety, design, and leadership. The platform offers news, webinars, summits, and educational content focused on AI adoption, automation, and operational excellence in research and analytical laboratories.

## Key Topics

- Lab Management
- Lab Leadership
- Lab Safety
- AI in Labs
- Laboratory Equipment
- Lab Automation
- Compliance
- Operational Efficiency
- Professional Development
- Lab Design
- Lab Software
- LIMS
- Agentic AI
- Lab AI Strategy & Readiness Certificate
- Lab Manager Academy

## Core Resources & Community

- [Lab Manager Homepage](https://www.labmanager.com): Hub for expert guidance on lab management, operations, safety, and business strategy.
- [Subscribe to Lab Manager](https://www.labmanager.com/subscribe): Subscription access to Lab Manager Essentials, Magazine, and Industry Perspectives newsletters.
- [Topics Directory](https://www.labmanager.com/topics): Topic directory covering cannabis, computer science, energy, engineering, and lab sciences.

## Lab Management & Operations

- [Lab Management](https://www.labmanager.com/category-group/management/lab-management): Comprehensive content on compliance, AI tools, efficiency, data integrity, and quality control.
- [Lab Leadership](https://www.labmanager.com/category-group/management/lab-leadership): Content on lab leadership covering management strategy, AI adoption, culture, and safety.
- [Lab Safety](https://www.labmanager.com/category-group/management/lab-safety): Lab safety content covering workplace safety, ergonomics, hearing protection, and OSHA compliance.
- [Lab Design](https://www.labmanager.com/category-group/management/lab-design): Lab design content on infrastructure, renovations, space utilization, and cleanroom design.

## Events, Summits & Professional Development

- [2026 Lab Manager Leadership Summit](https://summit.labmanager.com/leadership): 2026 Leadership Summit in Phoenix for lab managers, directors, and scientific leaders with training and networking.
- [Events & Webinars](https://www.labmanager.com/events): Live and on-demand events, webinars, and conferences on lab automation, AI, and management.
- [Summits](https://www.labmanager.com/summits): In-person and digital summits for lab professionals on management and professional development.
- [Webinars](https://www.labmanager.com/webinars): Webinar series on lab management, operations, leadership, and laboratory equipment.

## News & Industry Updates

- [News](https://www.labmanager.com/type/news): News articles on AI in labs, laboratory management, and emerging technologies in research.
- [News Collection](https://www.labmanager.com/type-group/news): Collection of lab news covering product announcements, AI, equipment, and lab leadership topics.
- [Press Releases](https://www.labmanager.com/type/press-releases): Press releases on lab equipment, LIMS software, automation, AI technology, and product launches.
- [Product News](https://www.labmanager.com/type/product-news): Product news covering lab equipment, software, automation, and analytical instruments.
